title: dryas octopetala var. ajanensis
intro: Dryas octopetala var. ajanensis, commonly known as Ajan Dryad or Ajan Mountain Rose, is a plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae) and is native to the Russian Far East. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. It is believed to have therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Dryas octopetala var. ajanensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
